unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Children love wearing spooky costumes on Halloween.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 孩子们喜欢在万圣节穿上搞怪的戏服。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 与custom（习俗）同源，特定场合穿的特定服装就是costume。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Asia is the largest continent in the world by area.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 按面积计算，亚洲是世界上最大的洲。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: con（共同）+ tin（保持）+ ent → 连成一体的大块陆地→ 大陆。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 碰撞; 使发出巨响 `n.` 撞车；倒闭 `adj.` 速成的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A truck went out of control and crashed into the back of a bus.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 拟声记忆：crash，重物撞击、碎裂的声音。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: People will focus on more creative and difficult tasks.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: create(创造) + ive -> 充满创造力的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The blue whale is the largest living creature on Earth.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 蓝鲸是地球上最大的现存生物。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: create（创造）+ -ure（名词后缀，指被创造物）→ 生物。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Farmers are busy harvesting crops before the heavy rain comes.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 农夫们正忙着在大雨来临前收割庄稼。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：农夫在大地上“割（crop）”成熟的庄稼。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 王冠；冕 v. 为……加冕
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The queen wore a shiny diamond crown on her head.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 女王头上戴着一顶闪闪发光的钻石王冠。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“刻拉温”——在王冠上刻出温暖的记号。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Stealing cars is a serious crime punished by law.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 偷车是受法律惩处的严重犯罪行为。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“开麦”——在法庭上开麦指证犯罪。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 罪犯 adj. 犯罪的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The police finally caught the dangerous criminal last night.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 警方昨晚终于抓住了那个危险的罪犯。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: crime（犯罪）+ -inal（形容词/名词后缀）= 罪犯的 / 罪犯。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 残忍的；冷酷的；残暴的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is cruel to treat animals in such a bad way.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 用这种糟糕的方式对待动物是残忍的。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“哭喔”——让弱者被打得直“哭喔”，太残忍了。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The water in the mountain stream is as clear as crystal.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 山涧溪水清澈见底，犹如水晶一般。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：crys（听起来像ice冰）+ tal（高山）→ 高山深处结出的冰晶、水晶。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Elephants are an important part of Thai life and culture.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀关联: 带有 -ture 后缀，和 nature (自然) 相对，是人类创造的文明文化 (culture)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'm curious about everything.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：cur（关心，注意）+ ious = 好奇的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 乳品店 adj. 乳品的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Milk, cheese, and butter are common dairy products.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 牛奶、奶酪和黄油是常见的乳制品。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 容易与diary（日记）混淆：d-a-i-r-y（牛奶店里飘奶香）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Which buildings were damaged in Seoul?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：dam（大坝）+ age（年龄）。大坝有年龄了，开始受到损坏。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He didn't dare to speak in front of the whole school.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他不敢在全校师生面前讲话。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“呆儿”——虽然是个呆萌的小孩，但关键时刻他“敢于”站出来。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Many students like to debate interesting topics with their classmates.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：de（加强）+ bate（打）-> 用言语打斗，即辩论。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The heavy fog caused a two-hour delay of our flight.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 大雾导致我们的航班延误了两小时。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: de（向下）+ lay（放置）→ 把事情放下以后再说→ 推迟、延误。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She works in the marketing department of a big tech company.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她在一家大型科技公司的市场部工作。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: depart（离开、分出）+ -ment（名词后缀）→ 从大机构中分出来的一个单位→ 部门。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Please check the departure board for your train time.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 请查看出发显示屏了解您的火车时间。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: depart（离开）+ -ure（名词后缀）= 离开，起程。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Does the writer give a clear description of the problem?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：de-（向下）+ script（写）+ -ion（名词后缀）→ 写下来的东西 → 描写，形容。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They will help you understand design better.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：de（下）+ sign（记号，画）= 绘下图纸，即设计。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: 2,400 homes destroyed.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：de（向下，变坏）+ stroy（建造，与structure同源）= 拆毁，摧毁。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The teacher gave us a detailed explanation of the grammar rules.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 老师对语法规则给我们做了详细的解释。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: detail（细节）+ -ed（形容词后缀，表示“具有……的”）= 详细的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I also read some digital books on the computer.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆: digit(数字) + al(形容词后缀) -> 数字的

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Add the endings: disappoint -> disappointed...
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词干法: dis (否定) + appoint (指定/承诺) -> 没能履行承诺，令人失望。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: News about natural disasters.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：dis-（否定/坏）+ aster（星星）= 坏星星，古人认为流星坠落代表灾难。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He looked at the winning lottery ticket in complete disbelief.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他满脸难以置信地看着那张中奖彩票。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: dis-（否定前缀）+ belief（相信）= 不相信，怀疑。
